newsapi.current_documented_history: Developer: up to one month; paid Business/Advanced: up to five years.
newsapi.terms_limitations: Terms prohibit reproducing/republishing copyrighted material and building a competing news database; Developer plan is development/testing only.
newsapi.historical_experiment_status: not_queried; available plan and permitted retention/use for the intended research corpus were not verified

yahoo_finance_yfinance.current_behavior: Yahoo quote search and ticker news results; no historical-news archive query is implemented.
yahoo_finance_yfinance.terms_limitations: Yahoo terms restrict reuse to create a database/archive that competes with or materially substitutes for Yahoo services/data.

alignment_implementation.cutoff: News published at or before the explicit cutoff; historical session alignment uses 16:00 America/New_York converted to UTC.
alignment_implementation.timestamp_policy: Missing, date-only, invalid, or timezone-naive publication timestamps are rejected.
alignment_implementation.relevance_policy: Exact normalized ticker metadata, provider query match, or exact ticker token in headline is required.
alignment_implementation.deduplication: Canonical HTTP(S) article reference with tracking parameters removed; otherwise stable SHA-256 of source, timestamp, and normalized title.
alignment_implementation.provenance: Retains publication time, source, canonical article reference, ticker/query relevance, and acceptance status.

historical_coverage.meaning: Coverage is unknown because no historical article corpus with verified access/retention rights was supplied. Zero here means no corpus was evaluated, not that the market had no news.

ablation.reason: No trustworthy, permitted, locally supplied point-in-time news archive was available for the historical walk-forward dates.
